title: ReputationRecord
description: Aggregated verification history for one (Principal, Capability) pair. A principal with zero completed tasks is NEUTRAL: counts are 0 and verification_rate is null (unknown), never 0.0 (failed-by-default).

principal_id.description: principal_id of the Principal this record scores.

capability_id.description: Capability.id this record scores the principal on.

tasks_verified.description: Count of tasks whose Evidence received a 'verified' verdict.

tasks_rejected.description: Count of tasks whose Evidence received a 'rejected' verdict.

verification_rate.description: Derived rate tasks_verified / (tasks_verified + tasks_rejected), in [0, 1]. MUST be null when both counts are 0 (neutral state).

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last update to this record.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
